title: instanceof against an unrelated class is always false, so its negation is always true

ground_truth.statement: PHP gives every object exactly one parent chain, and Beta is neither a parent nor an interface of Alpha, so no instance of Alpha (or of a subclass of Alpha) is an instance of Beta. `!($value instanceof Beta)` is true for every value the parameter can hold.

notes: Ground truth from the language; the runtime script also proves the structural claim through class_parents()/class_implements() rather than only sampling instances. Psalm words the same fact as 'Alpha cannot be identical to Beta', which is its RedundantCondition; the first draft of the expectation named TypeDoesNotContainType. Mago 1.57.0 reports nothing for this fixture although it has an impossible-type-comparison rule and fires it for other impossible comparisons.
